irregularities.IR-01: The pinned nflverse/nfldata commit is 733 commits behind upstream master, so the research snapshot no longer reflects the current season.
irregularities.IR-02: Upstream master moved on 2026-11-13, the same day as this review; the pin will keep drifting until DH-04 is answered.
irregularities.IR-03: Week 10 is only partly played. One of the frozen games has settled; the remaining sixteen have not, so no strategy verdict can change yet.
irregularities.IR-04: The official injury page read on 2026-11-13 lists 28 of the 32 clubs. Denver, Philadelphia, Tampa Bay and Chicago do not appear on it at this time.
irregularities.IR-05: The committed capture `data/availability/injuries.csv` carries a game-status value for 18 of 326 rows while this session's read of the same page carried one for 159 of 344. The difference is capture cadence, not a parser defect.
irregularities.IR-06: Two reads of the same official page 90 minutes apart differ in 381 cells. Any single read is a snapshot, and a designation is not a confirmation without the T-90m inactives and the final scoreboard.
irregularities.IR-07: One Jacksonville row on the official injury page could not be read unambiguously; it is recorded as unreadable rather than guessed.
irregularities.IR-08: Game-status values that the official page does not show are left blank in every published table. No string is invented for a player absent from a club chart.
